title: Bend the points, then cut with one line
brief: Write ReLU, its slope, and the merge of two affine layers, then watch two ReLU units turn XOR into a problem for one straight line.
hints: relu is np.maximum(x, 0.0). np.max would reduce the array to one number instead of comparing entry by entry.
relu_grad returns floats: (x > 0).astype(float). A boolean array fails the finite-difference comparison.
Apply the first layer, then the second, and write the result as W x + b: the first layer's matrix is on the right of the product, W2 @ W1, and b1 goes through the second layer as W2 @ b1.
